_comment: Temporal Signal Engine config. The static five-score model says HOW distressed a parcel is; this says WHY NOW. Recency-weights events (recent > old), rewards clustering (velocity), detects escalation SEQUENCES and NEGATIVE SPACE (an expected follow-up that never happened). Tune freely; add chains/rules as sources come online.

escalation_chains.name: failed_flip
escalation_chains.why: renovation then contractor lien -> stalled flip

escalation_chains.name: landlord_exit
escalation_chains.why: eviction -> can't re-rent -> converting to sale

negative_space_rules.name: eviction_no_relist
negative_space_rules.flag: eviction completed, unit not re-advertised (vacant/giving up)
